name: Restore a persistent StreamVoice login
steps: Log in with a valid account
expected: The console remains signed in and authentication errors are readable.

name: Create an account and immediately restore its session
description: Verifies signup creates a usable persistent session.
expected: The new account remains signed in and invalid duplicate identities are rejected.

name: Reject invalid account-setting changes
description: Verifies invalid settings changes are rejected with a clear error.
expected: Changes are rejected and the user sees a clear correction message.

name: Delete an account only after explicit confirmation
steps: Omit password or enter the wrong confirmation
expected: Deletion is blocked and the account remains signed in.

name: Show StreamVoice infrastructure status
description: Verifies the console shows configured infrastructure without secrets.
expected: The console clearly states that API routes are incomplete and PostgreSQL is not yet connected to the live API, without showing credentials.
